description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. An. D. Nimal Premawansha as a member of the Central Province Provincial Council from the Administrative District of Kandy
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a Provincial Council, which is an electoral process matter. It references the Provincial Councils Elections Act and involves the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a seat that became vacant due to a nullification. The content focuses on the electoral procedure and outcome, falling squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
